data.name: Halle
data.gender_notes: Halle is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German word hālah meaning 'hall' or 'house'. The name Halle symbolizes a welcoming and nurturing environment. In Christian tradition, Halle may be associated with the Holy Hall or the House of God. The name Halle carries the meaning “House, Hall” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Halle usually hope their child will grow to embody house, hall and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of hospitality and divine shelter.
data.etymology: Halle belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “House, Hall.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Halle total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: הללה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: הללה הוא שם שמקורו בשורש העברי 'הלל', שפירושו תשבחות, שמחה, ושבח לאל. הוא קשור קשר הדוק עם ביטויי שמחה והודיה בתנ'ך, ומשמש לעיתים קרובות בהקשר של תפילה ושבח.

in_greek.name: Χάλλη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Χάλλη προέρχεται από την ελληνική παράδοση και σχετίζεται με τις λέξεις χαρά, ευφροσύνη, και επαίνου. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόμοιες λέξεις χρησιμοποιούνται για να εκφράσουν χαρά και δοξολογία.

in_latin.name: Halle
in_latin.meaning: Halle - laudare, gaudere, et Deum celebrare
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Halle originem habet in vocibus Latinis laudare, gaudere, et Deum celebrare. In ecclesia primitiva, similes voces adhibebantur ad exprimendam laudem et gaudium in Deum.

in_english.name: Halle
in_english.meaning: Halle - a name signifying joy, praise, and celebration to God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Halle originates from Hebrew and Greek roots, signifying joy, praise, and celebration to God. It is associated with expressions of happiness and thanksgiving in the Bible. Historically, the name has been used in Christian traditions to reflect a spirit of jubilation and adoration. The name Halle symbolizes a personality that is cheerful, optimistic, and devout.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Halle, derived from Hebrew "hagal" meaning rock or rolling stone, symbolizes strength and stability in faith. It also represents the rolling away of the stone from Jesus' tomb, signifying new beginnings and resurrection.

historical_references.reference: Halle, a city in Saxony, Germany, was a significant center of the Protestant Reformation. Martin Luther is said to have preached there for the first time in 1523, and the city was one of the early adopters of the Lutheran faith.

Halle (Saale), now part of Halle an der Saale, was the birthplace of the famous German philosopher, Immanuel Kant, in 1724. Halle was an important intellectual center during the Enlightenment with a renowned university.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Halle has seen a modern resurgence in various fields, particularly in fashion, music, and events. On Instagram, there are numerous fashion influencers and bloggers bearing the name Halle. The hashtag #HalleStyle has over 12,000 posts, showcasing a diverse range of fashion trends and styles inspired by this name. In music, Halle Bailey, a sister duo consisting of Chloe and Halle Bailey, has gained significant popularity on Spotify with their R&B and soulful sound, amassing over 1 million monthly listeners. Lastly, Halle Berry, the renowned actress, continues to be a household name and regularly hosts events or attends red carpet functions, which can be found on Facebook Events.
